event_schema_notes.first_non_libc_library: first stack frame with a shared-library .so path after excluding libc, the ELF loader, and linux-vdso; it is the first recorded non-libc caller frame, not a symbolication claim beyond strace output.
event_schema_notes.function_symbol_offset_text: copied from strace function+offset where symbol text exists; null when stripped/unsymbolized.
event_schema_notes.reported_frame_ip: the hexadecimal frame value copied from strace; not converted to symbol-relative offset.
event_schema_notes.stage: D1/D2 probes recorded imports as coarse stages. Setter event ordering within a nested import is not separately marked; all events are in the native-import window and before the probe terminal.
event_schema_notes.syscall_line_sha256: SHA256 of the UTF-8 syscall source line without its trailing newline; root independently recomputed all 204 values.
